confidence_notes: FX from the RBA exchange-rate search (18 Nov 2026 reading). Food and drink anchors come from one search of crowdsourced cost-of-living indexes for Naha (Citycost, Worksplorer, Oysterlist). Those sources gave no cocktail price and showed wine only as a bottle price. Restaurant draft beer, cocktail and wine-by-the-glass are estimated from typical Japanese izakaya and bar pricing, at roughly ¥600-700 for beer, ¥900 for a cocktail and ¥850 for wine. The crowdsourced meal figures look low for a tourist-area restaurant, so I raised them somewhat. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings. Naha lodging is volatile and depends on season and events.
comparable_city_reasoning: Naha is a regional Japanese tourist city. Its restaurant prices are slightly above the national average, and its dining costs are below Tokyo's.
